title: Measure what each review round catches, then propose models and prompts per round
why: Owner question on item 356, 13:41 CST Nov 7: "should we also consider reworking our 3 round program in terms of what models they use what prompts etc?" Answered yes in the item's reply.
note: First measure, from review records: the findings per round, and how many were real. Then propose a model and prompt per round. A change to rule roles-review-cap-three or agent-model-cap needs the owner's word.
